slides.title: How a swapped cannon saved an empire
slides.text: How a swapped cannon saved an empire
slides.speech: To teleport 1 wizard, a magical university had to swap his body mass with a heavy military cannon. This wizard landed in the Agatean Empire, where a horde of elderly barbarians over eighty planned a palace coup. This chaotic revolution featured a teenage army inspired by a basic travel guide, and thousands of terra cotta golems controlled by magic armor. The war abruptly ended when the teleported cannon reappeared, instantly crushing the evil grand vizier before the wizard warped away.
